How we build your home

Six steps from an empty plot to your keys, with something you can keep at the end of each.

From plot to keys

Each step ends with something you keep: a brief, a plan, a signed specification, an approval set, a stage report and, at the end, your keys.

  1. Site visit

    We walk the plot with you and note orientation, access, soil and what your family needs.

  2. Design

    Floor plans, a 3D model and the front elevation, revised with you.

  3. Agreement

    An itemised estimate and a payment schedule tied to stages.

  4. Approval

    Submission and structural drawings, followed through with the authority.

  5. Construction

    Each stage checked by our engineer and shown to you before the next.

  6. Handover

    Interiors, a walkthrough together, your drawings and warranties, and the keys.

Build from anywhere

Every stage ends with photos, a short site video and the engineer's checklist, sent to your phone. Owners in Bengaluru, the Gulf and further away follow the whole build and visit when they choose.

You release the next payment after you have seen the finished stage.
